en.shortDescription: AI coding assistant with multi-provider support and browser automation
en.longDescription:
OpenClaw is an AI coding assistant with multi-provider LLM support and integrated browser automation.

Auth uses SERVICE_USER_OPENCLAW and SERVICE_PASSWORD_OPENCLAW. Gateway token uses SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_GATEWAYTOKEN.

de.longDescription:
OpenClaw ist ein KI-Coding-Assistent mit Multi-Provider-LLM-Unterstützung und integrierter Browser-Automatisierung.

Die Authentifizierung verwendet SERVICE_USER_OPENCLAW und SERVICE_PASSWORD_OPENCLAW. Das Gateway-Token verwendet SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_GATEWAYTOKEN.

fr.shortDescription: Assistant de codage IA avec support multi-fournisseurs et automatisation navigateur
fr.longDescription:
OpenClaw est un assistant de codage IA avec support LLM multi-fournisseurs et automatisation de navigateur intégrée.

L'auth utilise SERVICE_USER_OPENCLAW et SERVICE_PASSWORD_OPENCLAW. Le jeton de passerelle utilise SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_GATEWAYTOKEN.

pt.shortDescription: Assistente de codificação de IA com suporte multi-provedores e automação de navegador
pt.longDescription:
OpenClaw é um assistente de codificação de IA com suporte LLM multi-provedores e automação de navegador integrada.

A autenticação usa SERVICE_USER_OPENCLAW e SERVICE_PASSWORD_OPENCLAW. O token de gateway usa SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_GATEWAYTOKEN.
